name: David Plouffe

lean.basis: Democratic strategist: Obama's 2008 campaign manager and White House senior adviser, and senior adviser to Kamala Harris's 2024 campaign.

current_role: Democratic strategist; senior adviser to Kamala Harris's 2024 campaign
summary: David Plouffe managed Barack Obama's 2008 presidential campaign and served as a White House senior adviser from 2011 to 2013. He later led policy at the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (from 2017) and was a senior adviser to Kamala Harris's 2024 campaign.

connections.name: Barack Obama
connections.description: Plouffe managed Obama's 2008 presidential campaign and was a White House senior adviser from 2011 to 2013.

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: Plouffe joined Harris's 2024 campaign as a senior adviser in August 2024.

connections.name: Mark Zuckerberg
connections.description: Zuckerberg hired Plouffe in January 2017 to lead policy and advocacy at the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Worked alongside Biden in the Obama White House; in 2015 Plouffe reportedly helped persuade him not to challenge Hillary Clinton.

connections.name: Hillary Clinton
connections.description: Plouffe's 2008 strategy for Obama, built on the Iowa caucus and delegate math, beat Clinton's campaign; he later advised her 2016 run.

connections.name: Jen O'Malley Dillon
connections.description: Both worked on Obama's 2008 campaign and were senior leaders of Harris's 2024 campaign.
